summary: Iter-199 Inter-module Integrations. Frontend: /tools/solution-finder?seed=Hello%20World pre-fills SMART Goal field VERIFIED. /tools/pros-cons-wizard (new analysis) Step 1 renders the ⇄ 'Insert from other modules' button beside factor input (1 picker button detected via aria-label). Modal-open + pick assertion NOT VERIFIED end-to-end (modal detection failed after click — likely timing/render, not a code bug). /tools/ctt-task new-task page repeatedly redirected to /auth/login even after a successful super@test.com login (session preserved for /admin and /tools/solution-finder in the same run), so Classification 'Link to pre-existing item' and Dependencies 'Trigger from this task' launcher chips COULD NOT be verified end-to-end. ui_bugs.issue: Direct navigation to /tools/ctt-task after successful login redirects to /auth/login. In the same browser session, /admin and /tools/solution-finder loaded fine — auth state is present. Blocks E2E verification of the new Classification 'Link to pre-existing item' picker and Dependencies 'Trigger from this task' chips. Please investigate route guard / session hydration on this screen. Reference: /app/frontend/app/tools/ctt-task.tsx

The ⇄ button is rendered with accessibilityLabel='Insert from other modules' but no testID. Adds friction for automated testing. Suggest adding testID='pv-picker-open' (and testID on picked-item rows) so future runs can deterministically drive it. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/PassableValuePicker.tsx:137

action_items: Investigate why /tools/ctt-task redirects to /auth/login on a fresh authenticated session (route guard / auth hydration). Once fixed, retest Classification section 'Link to pre-existing item' picker + Dependencies section 'Trigger from this task' launcher chips (Solution Finder w/seed, MyDezider new-decision, Pros & Cons, Sub Task chain, LifeStyle, Goal).

Add testID='pv-picker-open' to InsertFromModulesButton and testID='pv-picker-item-<idx>' or category-based testID to picker rows in PassableValuePicker.tsx so the modal + pick flow can be automated deterministically.

Recommend main agent to self-verify these three UI flows in the preview: (1) Pros&Cons wizard Step 1 → click ⇄ → modal shows picker → pick a text row → factor name input fills, (2) MyDezider Step 2/6/7 ⇄ variants, (3) /tools/ctt-task Classification + Dependencies sections after fixing the redirect.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/integrations_passable.py:104 — SMART Goal.value is truncated to 140 chars (goal[:140]). Fine as a one-liner, but recognise this in UI to avoid picking a truncated goal into a factor name.
backend/routes/pros_cons.py:534 — sf_ref is stored as-is (dict). Consider validating minimum keys (entry_id) to reject malformed payloads early.
backend/routes/ctt_gem.py:81 — classification_ref accepts any shape (body.get). Consider Pydantic validation to enforce {type, ref_id, label}.
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates 1 decision with 2 options (opt-A worth 72%) + 1 pros-cons analysis (TEST_iter199 prefix) per run for regression. Frontend test created a Pros&Cons analysis 'TEST_iter199_wiz2'. Test data prefixed with 'TEST_iter199_' for cleanup.
